page.overview:
Who is Travis Willingham?

Travis Willingham is a human fighter from and . He is based on and played by the real Travis Willingham.

Travis Willingham the character looks exactly like Travis Willingham the actor.

Travis Willingham as a child looks exactly like Travis Willingham the actor as a child.

Travis Willingham the character lived a life almost exactly like Travis Willingham the actor, but he was involved in motion capture and voice acting on a fictional video game.
